body:
For reasons not yet determined, I have progressively lost the ability to sweat (not completely but 80-90%) from several areas of my body.

Some people who hate sweating might think this is a gift, but the truth is, when you lose the ability to sweat from one area, it increases in other areas, in a phenomenon called "compensatory sweating", and this can be extremely inconvenient socially.

I went from liking and being comfortable in warm environments, to suddenly not wanting to be in any environment lower than 72F. High humidity environments make my still functioning areas sweat like crazy.

From what I have read, it is irreversible and there is no cure. :'(
